definitions.explanation: The physical item in question, as opposed to a description, photo, or catalog listing. Often used when asking to see or inspect the real thing.

definitions.gloss: stock on hand; current inventory; display item
definitions.explanation: The last remaining item in stock, often a display model or floor sample sold at a discount.

examples.japanese: {現品|げんぴん}を{確認|かくにん}してください。
{写真|しゃしん}と{現品|げんぴん}の{色|いろ}が{少|すこ}し{違|ちが}う{場合|ばあい}があります。
examples.english: The color of the actual item may differ slightly from the photo.

examples.japanese: {注文|ちゅうもん}する{前|まえ}に、できれば{現品|げんぴん}を{見|み}ておきたい。
examples.english: Before ordering, I'd like to see the actual item if possible.

examples.japanese: {現品|げんぴん}{限|かぎ}り{半額|はんがく}セール。
examples.english: Half-price sale, limited to floor stock.

examples.japanese: この{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}は{現品|げんぴん}{処分|しょぶん}で{安|やす}くなっている。
examples.english: This refrigerator is discounted as a clearance display item.

examples.japanese: {現品|げんぴん}のため、{多少|たしょう}の{傷|きず}がある{場合|ばあい}がございます。
examples.english: As this is a display item, it may have minor scratches.

notes:
USAGE:
{現品|げんぴん} is used in retail, business, and online shopping contexts. Sense 1 emphasizes seeing or verifying the real thing, while sense 2 refers specifically to floor samples or last-in-stock items sold at a discount.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {現品|げんぴん}{確認|かくにん} (actual item inspection)
- {現品|げんぴん}{限|かぎ}り (limited to current stock / floor model only)
- {現品|げんぴん}{処分|しょぶん} (clearance of display items)
- {現品|げんぴん}{管理|かんり} (inventory control)
